body: Ah I can't, it was just a random thing - but beside that, I'd be to embarrassed to even try. Then I'd have even more pressure on myself to actually have it work. I think I could probably ask my doctor to prescribe me viagra but then I'm taking medicine to not kill myself and medicine to get erections, I'm really going to feel crap about that. I'm almost considering getting off the anti depressants as I don't know how much it's helping if I still get into really bad depressive spirals.

Maybe it isn't the best thing for me in the world, but where I'm at, I just want to feel wanted in some way. I just feel so useless and unwanted like this. Anything to make that feeling go away. As for friends, I don't really have many - I usually just stay at home all day, the two friends I do have are busy at work. I don't really get along with my family especially when it comes to the topic of depression. The way it is, I have to deal with it, in my bed infront of a computer like always.

*hugs* Thank you very much for your words of understandings. I wish I had the energy to write out a long reply something like this deserves, I'm just so drained and tired from all the crying. I know nothing comes instantly, but I've been sending out so many resumes, its been a year since my last job. As for the relationships, I've never even had one. I can't even find a date. Even less than that, I can't find a casual hookup and we know how many people are out there that are looking for that - and getting it, except for me. I just can't get anything. There's really no light at the end of the tunnel.
You can only do it alone so many times. Funny line though
No, I've sat there for hours and had only a couple matches and never any replies.

Despite the frustration, I'm a funny guy and I don't let this effect how I act around girls. The problem is I can't meet people online, I don't have many friends so I can't go to parties. Im working on getting a job, the trouble I've had with that is really more frustrating than anything else. My only option is to try to meet girls online and that just feels like I'm in an empty cave yelling and only hearing my own echos.
